facts.text: Under the Javelina Promise, eligible Texas undergraduate students with household income of $65,000 or less have tuition and fees covered for up to 4 years.

sources.title: Javelina Promise | Texas A&M University Kingsville
sources.quote: First time in college (FTIC), transfer undergraduate students and current continuing undergraduate students who qualify for Javelina Promise will have their tuition and fees fully covered for up to 4-years.
